inspiration.observed_pattern: INSTR returns the one-based first-match position of a needle in a string.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored scalar INSTR projection with an exact match, isolating the MariaDB integer result metadata from table setup, NULL handling, empty needles, and multibyte text.

fixture_notes: The fixed sentence contains INC-482 after ten preceding characters, isolating the one-based integer position contract.
determinism_notes: The scalar strings are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.

steps.sql: SELECT INSTR('Escalated INC-482 to review', 'INC-482') AS first_offset
